# PowerPlay v1.3.6 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Made destination handoffs stop an already-playing video before installing the transferred queue and starting the intended item.
- Prevented incomplete previous-player shutdowns from replacing a destination's existing queue.
- Coordinated source pause with the companion PowerLink integration's verified destination playback acknowledgment.

## Compatibility

For verified destination playback acknowledgment and source pausing, use the matching updated [PowerLink HACS integration](https://github.com/The-Power-0/PowerLink).
